name: Kipseli PropAMMWrapper quote-unit mismatch
summary: PropAMMWrapper paid out the integer returned by a USDC-denominated (6-decimal) quoter as raw units of tokenOut without asserting tokenOut was the quote token, so a WETH -> cbBTC route worth about 92 USDC transferred ~0.926 cbBTC (8 decimals) instead.

loss.notes: Imported from the seed inventory, which did not consistently distinguish gross from net loss or record valuation provenance.

ageReset.description: Provisional wrapper deployment only; engine/quote defect attribution and their latest causal activation are unresolved (source-5).

limitations: The wrapper deployment is not an established representative defect age: the excessive cbBTC is calculated/transferred in an underlying closed-source engine and its quote/route path (source-5).
Defect-bearing artifacts, causal route/token state history and their anchors remain unresolved.

sources.note: onchain review: victim is the verified PropAMMWrapper created 2026-04-14 by 0xaee25670e53e86e1e6247c77fdaaf422a3c55b8d (not the attacker), no Upgraded events - the exploited code was 7.5 days old. DefiLlama records $72,350 (Input Validation / Missing Input Validation, Base).

Partial review; no promotion. Source-1 eth_getTransactionReceipt and debug_traceTransaction(callTracer), Base block 45008655:171: logs 761/763/764/765 pass 0.04 WETH from attacker helper 0x74513519689b1fb427747624a4dd87b3849d39cd through wrapper 0xd35c6717, handler 0xa05de8fedaf5d47a6a8726811cc5f387bef1f816 and engine 0xc2be7b94d5498b1aceb914f3a1dec4ce502d235f to holder 0xbee3211ab312a8d065c4fef0247448e17a8da000. cbBTC log 766 takes 92610395 base units from that holder; 769/770 forward them through wrapper/helper to sender. Verified PropAMMWrapper source only forwards tokenOut/minOutAmount to immutable PropAMM 0x71c2ed90cc288229be59f26b8b3eef3c07d7ab99 and transfers its returned integer; the underlying engine actually sends the excess cbBTC. Trace engine swap selector 0xcce096f3 obtains quotes from 0x579f7d1ca8d2bac367375a834c288aa82fa49a07 (0x051c09ea) and 0xe00b0150ba21625353b69d82b3ec28a9a744b0c7 (0x6f3ac038), then calls 0x6ecc163517a0e77db8325822030c6540cb813ad3 (0x6e81b9b7); final amountOut is 92610395. Etherscan V2 getsourcecode returns no verified source for handler/engine. Wrapper creation is 0x33b0806abd379cb1f46838ebab4b67bf24b48c32ad74edd3f89e47e518e919d4 at 44684694 (1776158735); wrapper txlist through 45008655 has only creation, failed owner swap at 44772444, successful owner swap at 44772594. This misses internal calls and establishes neither first engine exercise nor full campaign. Unresolved: which engine/quote artifact or persistent token/route state produces the unit mismatch, its latest causal activation, earliest exercise and total loss. Next: retrieve/decompile runtimes for the traced engine/quote path, reproduce token/route pointer storage histories, inspect owner swap 0x4c0c75d586e86e10d92fbdea34915e4e21e472116d43a95a03515a47bb4b5be1 and complete handler/engine asset transfers before choosing targets or valuing a full episode.

limitations: Exact root-cause artifact/configuration, earliest engine exercise, complete campaign loss and age remain unresolved (source-5).
